name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_snap_points_near_node_model_xy
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::SnapPointsNearNodeModelXY snaps clip-polygon points to nearby model polygon vertices and XY edges after model vertices are copied into a linear rotated buffer.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and frontier for 0x46b030 validate the null exits, model pointer lookup through node user data, optional 0x200 bounds rejection, per-face vertex count handling, linear buffer allocation/copy, +90 X rotation, XY bounds overlap gate, polygon snap call with 0.100000001 tolerances, and final free of the linear buffer.
The native clip-polygon/model smoke verifies null/provider exits, model-bounds rejection, invalid short face handling, and successful vertex/edge snapping through a rotated model polygon.
